days.label: Day 1
days.caption: Day 1 installs the skeleton: four states (meal_preparation → eating → working → leaving) with two core pairs, bring-cereal and bowl-storage.

states.desc: Person is gathering ingredients and preparing food.
Person is consuming the meal.
Person is working on the laptop.
Person is leaving the desk.

triggers.text: Person places a bowl on the desk

meal_preparation.action: Pick up the cereal bag and place it next to the person.

triggers.text: Person opens laptop

eating.action: Pick up the empty bowl and place it in the designated storage area.

days.label: Routine Change
days.caption: Even when the user sits down with a bowl as before, taking vitamins before eating the cereal that the robot has just delivered causes the transition “person sits down” → “cereal to person” to be revised, after reflection, to “person sits down” → “vitamin to person”.
